title: Reword the test launcher's app-alias comment to cover any link whose stat is refused
outcome: Reword the test launcher's app-alias comment to cover any link whose stat is refused
acceptance: The comment above isFile() in scripts/test-launcher.mjs matches its behaviour: on Windows, a candidate whose stat is refused with EACCES is accepted when lstat reports any link (an app execution alias, a symlink or a junction), not only an app execution alias, and the comment notes that such a link earlier on PATH is chosen and fails at spawn rather than being skipped. Comment-only; no behaviour change.
